text_block_list.text: Today was finally the day of the tournament.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Just as in previous years, quite a large crowd has gathered.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Well, it is a major event for Tracen Academy, which draws attention from all over the country.

text_block_list.name: Ryan's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ryaaaan! Do your beeeest!!
We're rooting for you, Ryan—————!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Their cheers certainly carry an exceptional passion.
However, naturally—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fans
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! Show 'em what you're made of!
We're counting on a run worthy of the Mejiro name!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —As a horsegirl of the Mejiro family, I cannot afford to show anything less than perfection.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... you really are amazing, McQueen.
Always striving to fulfill your duty like that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is that why you believe it is acceptable to lose?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If your opponent runs with noble, elevated purpose,
is it acceptable to lose to them...? Is that what you believe, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Ryan, allow me to ask you once more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Why did you come to Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Race Official A
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san, Ryan-san!
Please prepare for gate entry!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (—When did it start?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(When did I lose track of whether it was okay to want to win?
Every time I look at you, I lose sight of it even more... When did it begin...?)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The horsegirls have entered the gates—
and the 3200m turf event is officially underway!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Drawing massive attention are, of course, these two!
From the prestigious Mejiro family: Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(McQueen... the horsegirl I look up to.
The one who carries the grace and pride befitting the heir to the prestigious Mejiro name...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since before I can remember, I've watched her from up close.
Her determination, her effort, her setbacks, and her resolve...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (That's why I feel like losing to her... to someone like her...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Is completely fine.
Is that... really what I've been thinking...?!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
1000 meters remaining, and the field is strung out! McQueen is in the lead group,
while Ryan is lingering toward the back, but does she seem to be lacking power in her stride?!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay! I took first place--!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan accelerates right here!
Look at that speed! She's fiercely closing the gap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(No! That's not true, I...!! Sure, I've spent
all this time wondering if I was allowed to want to win, but...!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Even so...! I've never once thought that it was okay to lose!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Not now! Not in any race! Even way back then,
when I raced you to the finish, I always--!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ---Aaaaaaaarrrrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Ryan...!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
They've entered the final stretch! McQueen is in the lead, with Ryan right on her heels!
Both unleash their final spurts, setting their sights on the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Oooorrrraaaahhh!!
Haaaaaaarrrrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
---AND THAT'S THE FINIIIIISH!!
The crowd erupts into deafening cheers for this nail-biting showdown!!

By the slimmest—the absolute barest of margins,
Mejiro McQueen claimed victory.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*huff*...... Gaaah, I lost!!
---Man, that stings!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...! Ryan, you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen, you asked me why I came to Tracen Academy, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If I just wanted to exercise, I could do that anywhere.
If working out was enough, I wouldn't need to race at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's why I came here... I came here to *win*.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To train, run, and compete—to become faster than anyone else.
...And to beat strong horsegirls like you, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... In that case, I shall gladly face you with everything I have.
For as a horsegirl of the Mejiro family, I too intend to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha!
---Well, when it comes to training, I'm not losing to anyone either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: With this body and these legs... I'm going to push myself as far as I can go!!

text_block_list.name: Male Ryan Fan
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Ryan!!
I'm definitely gonna be there to see you win next time!!

text_block_list.name: Female Ryan Fan
text_block_list.text: Me too! I'll be cheering you on forever and ever!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Ehehe... Thank you sooo much!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Thank you for helping me realize what's truly important.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, so... if it's all right with you, that is...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Would you please become my personal Trainer?!

And so, I became the official Trainer for Mejiro Ryan,
the refreshingly fit and upbeat horsegirl...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
............Huh? Wait, did what I just say sound like a confession?
Like, saying "my personal"... Wh-Wha-Wha-Whaaaaat...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Waaahhhh!! Forget that! Pleeease just forget I said thaaaat!!
